name: What are the most important features to include in an aging-in-place bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What are the most important features to include in an aging-in-place bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Key features for an aging-in-place bathroom include a zero-threshold or low-threshold walk-in shower with a built-in bench and grab bars. Slip-resistant flooring is crucial throughout the space. Other important additions are comfort-height toilets, wider doorways for wheelchair or walker access, lever-handle faucets, and good task lighting. These elements enhance safety, accessibility, and comfort for long-term independent living.
acceptedAnswer.description: Essential features include zero-threshold showers, grab bars, slip-resistant flooring, comfort-height toilets, wider doorways, and lever-handle faucets for safety and accessibility.
